sleeping_bag.name: AERIAL 250
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight down sleeping bag with specialized construction
sleeping_bag.description: Aerial 250 is presented as a specialized false-bottom ultralight sleeping bag for uncompromising users looking for maximum weight efficiency. The reduced underside insulation relies on the pad below, and the no-zipper construction aims to save weight.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 385 g total weight
- 250 g of 900 FP down
- Comfort 2 C / limit -4 C
- False-bottom construction
- No zipper
- H chamber design
- Toray Airtastic bottom fabric concept for the series
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus presents the Aerial line as setting a new standard in weight-to-insulation ratio and as a strong choice for extreme adventure pursuits and technical, weight-sensitive travel.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Extreme adventure pursuits, long-distance cycling races, technical multi-day hikes, highly weight-conscious adventures.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User-provided France capture shows 359 EUR. Indexed official Cumulus snippets from older crawls showed lower prices such as 349 EUR or 335 USD on other locales.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
